name: Lizard GT

engine.curve_basis: Export full-load torque minus exported frictionTorque, divided by absolute Pressure for forced induction; dynamic boost reapplied once
engine.name: Buddy mk1
engine.spool_basis: KDA response approximation from exported turbo inertia, size and pressure rate; export pressure map sets steady boost

warnings: PBR materials are approximated with KSP shaders; deformation and BeamNG Lua are excluded.
Metadata top speed is not imported; gearing and tire radius determine theoretical speed.
Tire width/compound calibration is a KSP approximation, not BeamNG contact-patch physics.
Suspension mesh fe6f7_suspension_r11 retained as rigid visual geometry; this layout has no independent-wheel animation anchors.

aero.source: Selected JBeam cefaero model; speed-squared density scaling

visual.suspension_animation_basis: Two-bone visual travel skin weighted by nearest exported fixed/hub nodes; unsupported layouts retained as rigid geometry; no steering or physics solver
visual.wheel_alignment_basis: Imported camber/toe removed from spinning meshes; axle roll and side mirroring retained; KDA part toe controls alignment

audio.source: Original KDA combustion synthesis, shared offline banks and runtime intake/boost/shift layers
assumptions: V8 defaults to a cross-plane sound preset; export metadata does not establish the crank type. Flat-plane is an editor override.

crew_setup: Attach a physical KDA race seat and doorway marker in the editor, then assign a Kerbal. The generated five-part craft is an uncrewed chassis.

mass_distribution.basis: Selected explicit JBeam node weights plus pressure-wheel ring masses at axle centers; reference-pose estimate

lighting.basis: Selected JBeam props, reference-node frames and glowMap simpleFunction; source ranges/colors retained, Unity brightness approximated.
warnings: Skipped glow material_47_abscreen_race_fe6f7: on-material is not included in the export.
